### Bible Pathways 03/09/2002
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-03-or-09-or-2002-1127494.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 25:17
Points:
- The Amalekites launched a cruel assault on the weak and weary Israelites trailing behind during the Exodus.
- God's command to wipe out Amalek was an execution of divine justice rather than personal retaliation.
- Scripture draws a sharp boundary between private vengeance and lawful justice.
- Civil leaders and legal systems are established by God to restrain evil and enforce righteousness.
